integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by an explicit complete face enumeration and a globally checked acyclic discrete-Morse matching; finite-field homology is only a cross-check, not a substitute for the Morse proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the order-13 Paley graph; no general Paley or conference-graph classification is claimed.
title: The neighborhood complex of the order-\(13\) Paley graph is a wedge of \(25\) two-spheres
